verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a changelog entry saying Pix can be turned on so Brazilian customers set up a recurring Pix Automático mandate at checkout. That is a first-party local payment method delivered through the existing Paddle checkout, so it counts toward the story. Multi-currency and localized pricing are adjacent capabilities, not payment methods, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented Apple Pay support, documented Google Pay support, bank-redirect methods (e.g., iDEAL/Bancontact), BNPL options, a consolidated list of supported payment methods, independent corroboration.
